summary: Qualified renter correctly disqualified; agent handled eligibility well but offered no alternate CTA.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hi, thanks for calling Summit Home Services. I'm Alex.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I'd like the free inspection for my apartment.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thanks for asking. Our free inspection is for homeowners. Are you the property owner?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: In that case we can't schedule the free homeowner inspection. You may want to ask your landlord to contact us.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Okay. Can you email me something I can forward to my landlord?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I don't have that option. Thanks for calling.
